public_comments.reason: The speaker is introducing a resolution related to immigrant heritage month and refugee day, expressing concern for the community.
public_comments.text: counselor med thank you council president it is an honor to introduce this year's 2025 immigrant refuge immigrant heritage month and world refugee day resolution but we would not be remiss without thinking about the current state that many of our refugee and immigrant neighbors find themselves in And although we are seeing challenges at the federal level and uncertainties, ends to refugee programs, travel bans that affect families, including mine, this year we want to reflect on the challenges that our refugee families and immigrant neighbors are still facing and how we as a community can help celebrate their importance and diversity in our community. Because many of them are still waiting to bring their loved ones, waiting to bring their wives, their husbands, their elderly parents, their children. And although there is uncertainty now and what will happen with the refugee program, what will happen with TPS, what will happen with travel bans, it is important that they know that we are still a welcoming city and we are still here for our refugee and immigrant neighbors. Thank you, Council President. And I believe we have Ramucho Karakezi here to speak on the resolution.
